tweet.text:
Vivaria includes a webapp and CLI to:
- Start containerized task environments and run AI agents
- View and annotate past runs with tags and comments
- Branch, edit, and redo previous runs
- Optionally provide agents with GPU access
- Store results in Postgres for further analysis
